scope: Focused source-grounded reconciliation, not a whole-M4 adherence pass or disposition of all 111 findings

findings.disposition: open API cleanup, no reachable production cutoff renewal established
findings.evidence: CommandSetup::enter, GatedCommandSetup::enter and CommandNamespaces::enter still select 30 seconds. GatedCommandSetup::execute uses enter_until(cutoff.deadline()?) and checks cutoff before child spawn. Historical callers use convenience entry. Preserve provenance when migrating callers; remove unused convenience entrypoints after caller audit.

StorageExecutionFailure Display emits outcome plus cleanup_error history. rejection-only retry retains history after recovery; busy-execution-v1 exercises successful status with failed cleanup. No Debug resource dump in this Display.

findings.disposition: partly implemented; broader diagnostic representation remains open
findings.evidence: BuildError has typed context/cache/publication errors, but Execution(String) still renders execution rejection. This does not lose retained-owner lifetime inside the execution API. A uniformly typed end-to-end diagnostic API is not complete.

Current TransformError::Dtb(String) and CacheError::Manifest(String) still erase dependency error types. Do not infer this requested improvement is fixed from old prose accepting typed diagnostic restoration elsewhere.

findings.disposition: error handling fixed; optional consolidation not completed
findings.evidence: NetworkNamespace::serve collects read_dir entries as Result<Vec<_>, _> before len check. No swallowed directory entry errors. A task-count sample does not prove lasting exclusivity; fresh helper construction supplies that invariant.

findings.disposition: tested on current amd64 kernel; broader configuration coverage remains open
findings.evidence: Existing runtime masks controls read-only, not kallsyms/keys/sched_debug. Added command checks for zero-or-unavailable kernel addresses, empty-or-unavailable key listing and unavailable scheduler debug, plus ordinary self proc access. Per-kernel observations do not prove every global proc interface is isolated. confinement-v7 failed its comm-name oracle; corrected PID oracle in v8 passes actual build/export. No seeded key control or proof for sched_debug-present configurations.

Production allowlist still includes splice/tee/vmsplice. No demonstrated escape. Do not remove these solely to satisfy a stale proposal; review ordinary pipe workloads and deny scope against actual requirement.

findings.disposition: trusted formatter boundary confirmed; hardening proposal remains unqualified
findings.evidence: Formatter role uses fresh mount/net/IPC/UTS namespaces, private propagation, captured runtime root and output-only block device, cleared environment and setup cutoff. It intentionally does not receive the untrusted-command seccomp/capability profile. Design explicitly trusts formatter; do not claim command-equivalent confinement or silently promote this suggestion into a new requirement.
Public ownership types require checking return-position inference and maintained plus historical consumers. Name-search counts do not establish dead APIs.
